literature.headline_zh: 季节性流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在这篇综述中,我们通过将聚糖依赖性附着的经典见解与 MHC-II 介导的进入的新数据相结合,讨论了 IAV 受体特异性的演变。 [10.1128/jvi.01443-25]
大流行后的 A(H3N2) 的特点是快速遗传漂变和多样化,以进化枝 2a.3a.1(J 谱系)为主,但抗原上不同的 K 亚进化枝(以前的 J.2.4.1)迅速出现。遗传和实验室检测(HI/中和)证实了免疫逃逸并减少了漂移毒株的疫苗匹配,而观察估计表明疫苗针对这些变异的有效性降低,而临床严重程度没有持续增加。 [10.3390/germs16030018]
在这里,我们发现 lncRNA GAPLINC 的表达因几种 IAV 毒株(包括 PR8、WSN、H3N2 和 H9N2)的感染而显着下调。 [10.1186/s13567-026-01783-1]

在8,246例入组的SARI病例中,4,149例接受了hMPV检测,检出59例阳性(1.42%;95%置信区间:1.10–1.83)。阳性率在2岁以下儿童中最高(2.9%),且在1月份达到峰值(2.1%);男性阳性率高于女性(1.7% vs 1.1%)。症状包括咳嗽(95%)、发热(88%)和呼吸困难(58%)。在54例有结局数据的患者中,11例需ICU入住,51例出院存活,3例死亡。 [10.1186/s12879-026-13958-4]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。
literature.lead_en: This literature brief prioritizes publications in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency and source convergence.
key_findings_en: In this review, we discuss the evolving landscape of IAV receptor specificity by integrating classical insights on glycan-dependent attachment with emerging data on MHC-II-mediated entry. [10.1128/jvi.01443-25]

Post-pandemic A(H3N2) is characterized by rapid genetic drift and diversification, with clade 2a.3a.1 (J lineage) predominating but the antigenically distinct K subclade (formerly J.2.4.1) rapidly emerging. [10.3390/germs16030018]
Here, we found that expression of lncRNA GAPLINC is significantly downregulated by infections with several strains of IAV, including PR8, WSN, H3N2, and H9N2. [10.1186/s13567-026-01783-1]

Among 8,246 enrolled SARI cases, 4,149 were tested for hMPV, yielding 59 positive cases (1.42%; 95% CI: 1.10–1.83). Positivity was highest in children aged <2 years (2.9%) and in January (2.1%), with males showing higher positivity than females (1.7% vs 1.1%). [10.1186/s12879-026-13958-4]

Among 97 adults (51 H1N1 mono-positive; 46 dual-positive), dual positivity was associated with lower PaO2/FiO2 (244.17 vs 293.94; p=0.018), higher CRP and IL-6, more invasive ventilation (23.9% vs 7.8%; p=0.047), and more fungal co-detection (47.8% vs 25.5%; p=0.034). [10.1016/j.ijid.2026.108985]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.caveats_en: Some evidence is abstract-only, observational or derived from narrative reviews; conclusions should be interpreted in light of study design and evidence strength.

papers.title: Genomic and Antigenic Evolution of Influenza A(H3N2) After the COVID-19 Era: A Scoping Review with Focus on J and K Subclades and Implications for Vaccine Effectiveness
papers.abstract: Post-COVID-19, influenza A(H3N2) has re-emerged with accelerated genetic diversification. The rise in antigenically drifted subclades raises concerns regarding immune escape and vaccine mismatch. To synthesize the available evidence on the post-pandemic evolution of influenza A(H3N2), with particular attention to emerging subclades and their potential public health implications, a scoping review (PRISMA-ScR) was conducted across six databases in January 2026, including studies on genomic surveillance, antigenic characterization, and vaccine effectiveness (VE). Twenty studies were included. While clade 2a.3a.1 (J lineage) predominated, reports highlighted the rapid emergence of the antigenically distinct K subclade (formerly J.2.4.1). Genetic and laboratory assays (HI/neutralization) confirmed immune escape and reduced vaccine match. Observational estimates indicated diminished VE against drifted strains, though no consistent increase in clinical severity was observed. Post-pandemic A(H3N2) is defined by rapid drift and diversification. Emerging variants like the K subclade challenge vaccine selection and seasonal preparedness. Integrated surveillance remains vital for timely vaccine updates and mitigating public health impact.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述研究了后 COVID-19 时代甲型流感 (H3N2) 的基因组和抗原进化,重点关注 J 和 K 亚支及其对疫苗有效性的影响。核心问题涉及大流行后 A(H3N2) 毒株加速的遗传多样性和抗原漂移如何影响免疫逃逸、疫苗不匹配和公共卫生准备。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 2026 年 1 月,对六个数据库进行了范围界定审查 (PRISMA-ScR),以综合有关大流行后甲型 H3N2 流感演变的证据,包括基因组监测、抗原表征和疫苗有效性研究。根据预先确定的资格标准纳入了二十项研究。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 大流行后的 A(H3N2) 的特点是快速遗传漂变和多样化,以进化枝 2a.3a.1(J 谱系)为主,但抗原上不同的 K 亚进化枝(以前的 J.2.4.1)迅速出现。遗传和实验室检测(HI/中和)证实了免疫逃逸并减少了漂移毒株的疫苗匹配,而观察估计表明疫苗针对这些变异的有效性降低,而临床严重程度没有持续增加。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了不同分支之间抗原漂移和免疫逃逸的异质性,并且对漂移菌株引起的感染的临床严重程度的研究结果相互矛盾。此外,证据基础缺乏关于 K 亚支快速出现的机制及其除疫苗错配之外的公共卫生影响的一致数据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 像 K 亚支这样的新兴变异需要综合基因组和抗原监测,以便及时选择疫苗株和做好季节性准备。加强监测系统对于减轻公共卫生影响至关重要,特别是考虑到免疫逃逸和疫苗有效性降低带来的挑战。

papers.title: The receptor landscape of influenza A viruses
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Influenza A viruses (IAVs) have a remarkable ability to adapt to new host species, which has been attributed to the specificity of the viral hemagglutinin (HA) for sialylated glycans and the functional balance between HA and the viral neuraminidase (NA). For decades, sialic acids on N - and O -linked glycans and glycosphingolipids were considered the only receptors that govern IAV entry, tropism, and species specificity. However, the discovery of bat-derived H17N10 and H18N11 viruses, followed by the identification of an avian H19 subtype, has fundamentally challenged this concept. These viruses use major histocompatibility complex class II (MHC-II) molecules as entry receptors independent of sialic acid binding. Moreover, recent studies demonstrate that certain H2N2 and H3N2 viruses exhibit dual receptor specificity, engaging both sialic acids and MHC-II, thereby expanding the conceptual understanding of IAV receptor usage. In this review, we discuss the evolving landscape of IAV receptor specificity by integrating classical insights on glycan-dependent attachment with emerging data on MHC-II-mediated entry. We discuss the structural determinants of sialic acid and MHC-II receptor engagement, the plasticity of HA receptor-binding sites, and the consequences of exclusive or dual receptor usage on host range and zoonotic potential. We further examine how MHC-II tropism shifts cellular targeting toward antigen-presenting cells and intestinal immune niches, and how this shift may relax selective constraints on NA function.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:甲型流感病毒(IAV)具有显着的适应新宿主物种的能力,这归因于病毒血凝素(HA)对唾液酸化聚糖的特异性以及HA和病毒神经氨酸酶(NA)之间的功能平衡。几十年来,N-和O-连接聚糖和鞘糖脂上的唾液酸被认为是控制IAV进入、向性和物种特异性的唯一受体。然而,蝙蝠源性 H17N10 和 H18N11 病毒的发现,以及随后禽类 H19 亚型的鉴定,从根本上挑战了这一概念。这些病毒使用主要组织相容性复合物 II 类 (MHC-II) 分子作为独立于唾液酸结合的进入受体。此外,最近的研究表明,某些 H2N2 和 H3N2 病毒表现出双重受体特异性,同时涉及唾液酸和 MHC-II,从而扩大了对 IAV 受体使用的概念理解。在这篇综述中,我们通过将聚糖依赖性附着的经典见解与 MHC-II 介导的进入的新数据相结合,讨论了 IAV 受体特异性的演变。我们讨论了唾液酸和 MHC-II 受体结合的结构决定因素、HA 受体结合位点的可塑性,以及独占或双重受体使用对宿主范围和人畜共患潜力的影响。我们进一步研究 MHC-II 向性如何将细胞靶向转向抗原呈递细胞和肠道免疫生态位,以及这种转变如何放松对 NA 功能的选择性限制。

papers.title: Trends of severe human metapneumovirus infections in India
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In December 2024 and early January 2025, China reported increased acute respiratory infections with increased detections of seasonal influenza, rhinovirus, RSV and hMPV during the Northern Hemisphere winter. We strengthened hMPV surveillance through the existing pan-India surveillance network for acute respiratory illness (ARI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). METHODOLOGY: To rapidly generate nationwide situational data without overburdening laboratories already performing routine respiratory virus surveillance, each site was asked to test up to five eligible SARI samples per week for hMPV from January to April 2025. Eligible samples were hospitalized SARI cases that were negative for influenza, SARS-CoV-2 and/or RSV, as applicable to age-based testing algorithms, across 70 laboratories. RESULTS: Of 8,246 enrolled SARI cases, 4,149 eligible samples were tested for hMPV under the capped weekly sampling strategy, and 59 were positive (1.42%; 95% CI: 1.10-1.83). Positivity ranged from 0.5% to 2.9% across age groups and was highest in children aged <2 years. Most patients (63%) were aged <2 years. Positivity was higher among males (1.7% vs 1.1% in females), and was highest in January (2.1%) before declining to 0.5% in April. The most common symptoms were cough (95%), fever (88%), and breathlessness (58%). Outcomes were available for 54/59 patients: 11 required ICU admission, 51 were discharged alive, and 3 died. Among seven patients with comorbidities, all were discharged alive. More than half of the sequenced viruses belonged to clade B1, followed by B2 and A2b2. CONCLUSION: In this limited sentinel surveillance of severe respiratory infections, hMPV was detected infrequently but was observed predominantly among young children. Continued multi-season surveillance is needed to better define age-specific burden, temporal patterns, and circulating genotypes in India. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) infections contribute to acute respiratory illness (ARI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) globally, yet their burden and epidemiology in India remain insufficiently characterized. The study was prompted by reports of increased respiratory infections and hMPV detections in China during the 2024-2025 winter, highlighting a potential knowledge gap regarding hMPV trends in India.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A sentinel surveillance study was conducted across 70 laboratories in India from January to April 2025, leveraging an existing pan-India ARI/SARI network. Eligible participants were hospitalized SARI cases negative for influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and/or RSV, with up to five samples tested weekly per site to avoid overburdening laboratories.
analysis.methods: Samples were tested for hMPV using standardized assays integrated into routine respiratory virus surveillance protocols. A capped weekly sampling strategy (up to five SARI samples per site) was implemented to generate nationwide situational data efficiently.
analysis.main_results: Among 8,246 enrolled SARI cases, 4,149 were tested for hMPV, yielding 59 positive cases (1.42%; 95% CI: 1.10–1.83). Positivity was highest in children aged <2 years (2.9%) and in January (2.1%), with males showing higher positivity than females (1.7% vs 1.1%). Symptoms included cough (95%), fever (88%), and breathlessness (58%). Among 54 patients with outcome data, 11 required ICU admission, 51 were discharged alive, and 3 died.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrates that hMPV contributes to a small but measurable proportion of severe respiratory infections in India, predominantly affecting young children. It provides the first multi-site, time-bound estimate of hMPV burden in Indian SARI cases, identifying clade B1 as the most prevalent circulating genotype.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings underscore the need for sustained, age-stratified hMPV surveillance in India to inform clinical management and public health strategies, particularly for pediatric populations. Genotypic data can guide vaccine development and antiviral strategies targeting circulating clades.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s limited duration (January–April 2025) and capped sampling strategy may underestimate true hMPV burden, particularly outside peak winter months. The absence of a full-year dataset and limited outcome data for some patients reduce the strength of conclusions about severity and risk factors.

papers.title_zh: 印度严重人类偏肺病毒感染的趋势
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: In December 2024 and early January 2025, China reported increased acute respiratory infections with increased detections of seasonal influenza, rhinovirus, RSV and hMPV during the Northern Hemisphere winter. We strengthened hMPV surveillance through the existing pan-India surveillance network for acute respiratory illness (ARI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). METHODOLOGY: To rapidly generate nationwide situational data without overburdening laboratories already performing routine respiratory virus surveillance, each site was asked to test up to five eligible SARI samples per week for hMPV from January to April 2025. Eligible samples were hospitalized SARI cases that were negative for influenza, SARS-CoV-2 and/or RSV, as applicable to age-based testing algorithms, across 70 laboratories. RESULTS: Of 8,246 enrolled SARI cases, 4,149 eligible samples were tested for hMPV under the capped weekly sampling strategy, and 59 were positive (1.42%; 95% CI: 1.10-1.83). Positivity ranged from 0.5% to 2.9% across age groups and was highest in children aged <2 years. Most patients (63%) were aged <2 years. Positivity was higher among males (1.7% vs 1.1% in females), and was highest in January (2.1%) before declining to 0.5% in April. The most common symptoms were cough (95%), fever (88%), and breathlessness (58%). Outcomes were available for 54/59 patients: 11 required ICU admission, 51 were discharged alive, and 3 died. Among seven patients with comorbidities, all were discharged alive. More than half of the sequenced viruses belonged to clade B1, followed by B2 and A2b2. CONCLUSION: In this limited sentinel surveillance of severe respiratory infections, hMPV was detected infrequently but was observed predominantly among young children. Continued multi-season surveillance is needed to better define age-specific burden, temporal patterns, and circulating genotypes in India. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

papers.title: In vitro and in vivo studies of GAPLINC identify it as a critical host factor involved in the regulation of influenza A virus infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Although previous studies have suggested a role for GAPLINC in regulating influenza A virus (IAV) infection, the functional involvement of GAPLINC in IAV infection in vitro and in vivo remains largely unknown. Here, we found that expression of lncRNA GAPLINC is significantly downregulated by infections with several strains of IAV, including PR8, WSN, H3N2, and H9N2. Interestingly, infections with several other viruses, such as pseudorabies virus (PRV), Sendai virus (SeV), and Herpes simplex virus (HSV), also result in a significant reduction in GAPLINC expression. During IAV infection, activation of NF-κB and the downstream IL-6/STAT3 signaling pathway contribute, at least in part, to the downregulation of GAPLINC expression. Knockdown of GAPLINC in host cells impairs the viral replication, whereas overexpression of GAPLINC increases the viral titers. Both heterozygous GAPLINC knockout (KO) mice (GAPLINC +/- ) and homozygous GAPLINC KO mice (GAPLINC −/− ) were further employed to determine its function in vivo. GAPLINC knockout renders mice more resistant to IAV infection than wild-type counterparts, as evidenced by lower viral load and lung injury, slower body weight loss, and improved survival. We confirmed that GAPLINC obviously suppresses the IRF3 activation in IAV-infected cells. Moreover, we noticed that inhibition of ATG7-involved autophagy weakens the pro-viral activity of GAPLINC. Together, the results support the conclusion that GAPLINC plays a critical role in enhancing the pathogenesis of IAV, at least by targeting the IRF3 and ATG7-mediated autophagy pathway.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管之前的研究表明 GAPLINC 在调节甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 感染中发挥作用,但 GAPLINC 在体外和体内 IAV 感染中的功能参与仍然很大程度上未知。在这里,我们发现 lncRNA GAPLINC 的表达因几种 IAV 毒株(包括 PR8、WSN、H3N2 和 H9N2)的感染而显着下调。有趣的是,其他几种病毒的感染,如伪狂犬病病毒 (PRV)、仙台病毒 (SeV) 和单纯疱疹病毒 (HSV),也会导致 GAPLINC 表达显着降低。在 IAV 感染期间,NF-κB 和下游 IL-6/STAT3 信号通路的激活至少部分地导致 GAPLINC 表达的下调。宿主细胞中 GAPLINC 的敲低会损害病毒复制,而 GAPLINC 的过度表达会增加病毒滴度。进一步采用杂合 GAPLINC 敲除 (KO) 小鼠 (GAPLINC +/- ) 和纯合 GAPLINC KO 小鼠 (GAPLINC −/− ) 来确定其体内功能。GAPLINC 敲除使小鼠比野生型小鼠对 IAV 感染具有更强的抵抗力,病毒载量和肺损伤较低、体重减轻较慢以及生存率提高就证明了这一点。我们证实 GAPLINC 明显抑制 IAV 感染细胞中 IRF3 的激活。此外,我们注意到抑制 ATG7 相关的自噬会削弱 GAPLINC 的前病毒活性。总之,这些结果支持这样的结论:GAPLINC 在增强 IAV 的发病机制中发挥着关键作用,至少是通过靶向 IRF3 和 ATG7 介导的自噬途径。

papers.title: Occupationally Exposed and General Population Antibody Profiles to Influenza A Viruses Circulating in Swine as Indication of Zoonotic Risk
papers.abstract: Persons with occupational exposure to swine might be at disproportionate risk for zoonotic swine influenza A virus. To evaluate human antibody responses, we tested serum or plasma from swine veterinarian, farm employee, and general population cohorts by hemagglutination inhibition assays against representative swine and human seasonal influenza vaccine strains. We analyzed hemagglutination inhibition data by antigenic cartography to assess strain relationships and reproduction number modeling to evaluate pandemic potential using age-stratified immunity profiles. Occupationally exposed groups had lower human seasonal vaccine uptake (45.5% vs. 70%) and lower odds of seropositivity to several H1 and H3 strains from swine than did general population cohorts. One swine strain exhibited significant antigenic drift (3.62 antigenic units) from its nearest vaccine strain. Multiple strains required lower reproduction number thresholds for pandemic spread (1.09–1.35) than recorded pandemic strains (1.46–1.80), demonstrating that population immunity gaps heighten zoonotic risk to circulating swine H1 and H3 strains.

papers.title: Current Development of Small Molecules Against Influenza A Virus by Targeting Hemagglutinin
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Influenza A virus (IAV) continues to be one of the most serious health burdens causing widespread illness and mortality. Limited efficacy and reduced susceptibility of available drugs and vaccines to the emergence of resistant strains have spurred the pursuit of alternative treatment strategies. Hemagglutinin (HA), essential for viral attachment and membrane fusion in the first step of the virus infection cycle, has emerged as an attractive target. Over the past few decades, HA has garnered considerable attention, and significant progress has been achieved in the discovery of HA modulators, even though no anti‐IAV drugs targeting HA have been approved by the FDA. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the current landscape of HA inhibitors and degraders, mainly focusing on the systematic structure–activity relationship (SAR) exploration of both synthetic and natural product (NP)‐derived small molecules endowed with abundant structural frameworks, together with a brief introduction of different binding modes based on cocrystal structures of IAV HAs and HA inhibitors. We anticipate that this review will serve as practical guidance for the development of urgently needed, more effective, and structurally innovative HA‐targeting drugs capable of addressing the escalating challenge of drug resistance.

papers.title: Dual-subtype positivity of influenza A(H1N1) and A(H3N2) is associated with worse hypoxemia, fungal co-detection, and adverse short-term outcomes in adults with influenza-associated community-acquired pneumonia.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dual-subtype influenza A positivity is poorly characterized. We evaluated whether detection of A(H1N1) and A(H3N2) during the same admission identifies a high-risk phenotype in adults hospitalized with influenza-associated community-acquired pneumonia. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study linked clinical and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid pathogen-spectrum records. Influenza A was detected by RT-PCR and BALF pathogens by targeted next-generation sequencing. The primary endpoint was composite adverse hospital disposition (in-hospital death or discharge against medical advice [DAMA]); components were reported separately. Associations were estimated with binomial generalized linear models and Firth sensitivity analyses. RESULTS: Among 97 adults (51 H1N1 mono-positive; 46 dual-positive), dual positivity was associated with lower PaO2/FiO2 (244.17 vs 293.94; p=0.018), higher CRP and IL-6, more invasive ventilation (23.9% vs 7.8%; p=0.047), and more fungal co-detection (47.8% vs 25.5%; p=0.034). Composite adverse disposition occurred in 26.1% versus 3.9% (OR 8.65; p=0.003); the age- and sex-adjusted OR was 8.24 (p=0.010) and attenuated after PaO2/FiO2 adjustment (OR 4.38; p=0.147). In-hospital death was 15.2% versus 3.9% (p=0.081). CONCLUSIONS: Dual positivity identified a severe hypoxemic phenotype with greater fungal co-detection. Oxygenation was the principal clinical correlate of excess risk.

papers.title_zh: 甲型 H1N1 和甲型 H3N2 流感双亚型阳性与患有流感相关社区获得性肺炎的成人患者更严重的低氧血症、真菌共检出和不良短期结果相关。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dual-subtype influenza A positivity is poorly characterized. We evaluated whether detection of A(H1N1) and A(H3N2) during the same admission identifies a high-risk phenotype in adults hospitalized with influenza-associated community-acquired pneumonia. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study linked clinical and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid pathogen-spectrum records. Influenza A was detected by RT-PCR and BALF pathogens by targeted next-generation sequencing. The primary endpoint was composite adverse hospital disposition (in-hospital death or discharge against medical advice [DAMA]); components were reported separately. Associations were estimated with binomial generalized linear models and Firth sensitivity analyses. RESULTS: Among 97 adults (51 H1N1 mono-positive; 46 dual-positive), dual positivity was associated with lower PaO2/FiO2 (244.17 vs 293.94; p=0.018), higher CRP and IL-6, more invasive ventilation (23.9% vs 7.8%; p=0.047), and more fungal co-detection (47.8% vs 25.5%; p=0.034). Composite adverse disposition occurred in 26.1% versus 3.9% (OR 8.65; p=0.003); the age- and sex-adjusted OR was 8.24 (p=0.010) and attenuated after PaO2/FiO2 adjustment (OR 4.38; p=0.147). In-hospital death was 15.2% versus 3.9% (p=0.081). CONCLUSIONS: Dual positivity identified a severe hypoxemic phenotype with greater fungal co-detection. Oxygenation was the principal clinical correlate of excess risk.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:双亚型甲型流感阳性的特征尚不清楚。我们评估了在同一入院期间检测出 A(H1N1) 和 A(H3N2) 是否可以识别因流感相关社区获得性肺炎住院的成人的高危表型。方法:这项回顾性单中心研究将临床和支气管肺泡灌洗液病原体谱记录联系起来。通过 RT-PCR 检测甲型流感,通过靶向下一代测序检测 BALF 病原体。主要终点是复合不良医院处置(院内死亡或不顾医疗建议出院 [DAMA]);成分单独报告。通过二项式广义线性模型和 Firth 敏感性分析来估计关联性。结果:在 97 名成人(51 名 H1N1 单阳性;46 名双阳性)中,双阳性与较低的 PaO2/FiO2(244.17 vs 293.94;p=0.018)、较高的 CRP 和 IL-6、更多的有创通气(23.9% vs 7.8%;p=0.047)以及更多的真菌联合检测(47.8%)相关。对比 25.5%;p=0.034)。复合不良处置发生率分别为 26.1% 和 3.9%(OR 8.65;p=0.003);年龄和性别调整后的 OR 为 8.24 (p=0.010),并在 PaO2/FiO2 调整后减弱(OR 4.38;p=0.147)。院内死亡率分别为 15.2% 和 3.9% (p=0.081)。结论:双重阳性确定了严重的低氧血症表型,同时检测出更多的真菌。氧合是过度风险的主要临床相关因素。

papers.title: Analysis of Influenza A viruses using the resonant recognition model
papers.abstract: Bird flu (Avian influenza) and human flu are both caused by Influenza A viruses, but they differ significantly in their host adaptation, transmission and severity. Here, we have used the Resonant Recognition Model (RRM), which is innovative approach using knowledge from quantum physics, biochemistry and mathematics, capable to analyse interactions between proteins and their targets, including other proteins, DNA, RNA, or small molecules. Using the RRM model we have identified different characteristics for different types of flu viruses, and we have found that there are three groups of flu viruses with completely different interactions with host cells receptors. Such finding can provide explanation why different flu viruses can interact only with specific hosts and why there is extremely low cross infection between different species, in particular between birds and humans.
papers.journal: International Journal of Science and Research Archive

papers.title: Decoding the lung-brain axis in influenza: from pulmonary infection to central nervous system injury
papers.abstract: Influenza viruses are respiratory pathogens of the family Orthomyxoviridae. Among the four recognized types, influenza A virus (IAV) is the primary cause of seasonal epidemics and pandemics. Continuous antigenic drift facilitates immune evasion, whereas occasional antigenic shift drives the emergence of novel hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) subtype combinations. Although influenza is primarily characterized by respiratory manifestations, it can also cause severe central nervous system (CNS) complications, including encephalitis, collectively referred to as influenza-associated encephalopathy (IAE), which is associated with poor clinical outcomes and remains frequently overlooked. The neurotropic potential of influenza viruses remains controversial. Although vaccination and antiviral therapies effectively reduce influenza-related morbidity and mortality, specific preventive and therapeutic strategies for influenza-associated CNS complications remain limited. This review synthesizes current evidence on the neuroinvasive characteristics of influenza viruses, including susceptibility factors, viral determinants, host responses, pathogenic mechanisms, therapeutic strategies, and prognostic indicators. Particular emphasis is placed on the mechanisms underlying CNS injury, including both direct viral invasion and indirect injury mediated by dysregulated immune and inflammatory responses. By integrating these emerging mechanistic insights, this review proposes a lung-brain axis framework to explain the bidirectional communication between pulmonary infection and neurological injury during influenza. This framework provides an updated perspective on the pathogenesis of IAE, identifies potential therapeutic targets, and may facilitate future studies aimed at improving early diagnosis, risk stratification, and the development of mechanism-based interventions.

papers.abstract_zh: 流感病毒是正粘病毒科的呼吸道病原体。在四种公认的类型中,甲型流感病毒(IAV)是季节性流行病和大流行的主要原因。持续的抗原漂移有利于免疫逃避,而偶尔的抗原漂移则推动了新型血凝素(HA)和神经氨酸酶(NA)亚型组合的出现。尽管流感主要以呼吸道症状为特征,但它也可引起严重的中枢神经系统(CNS)并发症,包括脑炎,统称为流感相关脑病(IAE),它与不良的临床结果相关,并且经常被忽视。流感病毒的神经营养潜力仍然存在争议。尽管疫苗接种和抗病毒治疗有效降低了流感相关的发病率和死亡率,但流感相关中枢神经系统并发症的具体预防和治疗策略仍然有限。本综述综合了流感病毒神经侵袭特征的最新证据,包括易感因素、病毒决定因素、宿主反应、致病机制、治疗策略和预后指标。特别强调中枢神经系统损伤的机制,包括直接病毒入侵和由免疫和炎症反应失调介导的间接损伤。通过整合这些新兴的机制见解,本综述提出了一个肺脑轴框架来解释流感期间肺部感染和神经损伤之间的双向通讯。该框架提供了关于 IAE 发病机制的最新观点,确定了潜在的治疗靶点,并可能促进旨在改善早期诊断、风险分层和基于机制的干预措施的开发的未来研究。

papers.title: Cost and Safety Perceptions as Determinants of COVID-19 Vaccination Intention in Saudi Arabia
papers.abstract: Background: Public acceptance of vaccines during emerging infectious disease outbreaks is influenced by perceptions of safety, accessibility, and cost. Understanding these determinants during the early phase of a pandemic is important for informing vaccination policy and communication strategies. This study examined the role of vaccine cost and safety perceptions in shaping COVID-19 vaccination intention among adults in Saudi Arabia prior to national vaccine rollout. Methods: A cross-sectional electronic survey was conducted among adults residing in Saudi Arabia between August and September 2020. Participants were recruited through online distribution using social media and electronic communication channels. The questionnaire assessed socio-demographic characteristics, knowledge and perceptions regarding COVID-19, and intention to receive COVID-19 vaccination under five hypothetical scenarios reflecting vaccine cost and the availability of scientific safety and efficacy evidence. Multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with vaccination intention. Results: A total of 1293 respondents completed the survey. When vaccination was offered free of charge, 57.5% of participants reported that they would likely receive the vaccine. Vaccination intention declined as the hypothetical vaccine price increased, reaching 38.7% when the cost exceeded 100 SAR. Intention was lowest when vaccination was presented under conditions in which safety and efficacy evidence had not yet been confirmed. Age, gender, educational attainment, and prior seasonal influenza vaccination were associated with COVID-19 vaccination intention across several scenarios. Conclusions: Perceived vaccine affordability and confidence in scientific safety and efficacy evidence were important factors associated with COVID-19 vaccination intention during the early phase of the pandemic in Saudi Arabia. Providing vaccination without direct cost to recipients and communicating safety and efficacy evidence transparently may support public confidence and vaccine acceptance during future large-scale immunization campaigns. These findings should be interpreted as an early-pandemic baseline and should not be extrapolated to current post-rollout attitudes.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:新发传染病爆发期间公众对疫苗的接受程度受到对安全性、可及性和成本的看法的影响。在大流行的早期阶段了解这些决定因素对于制定疫苗接种政策和沟通策略非常重要。本研究探讨了在全国疫苗推出之前,疫苗成本和安全性认知在沙特阿拉伯成年人中塑造 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿方面的作用。方法:对 2020 年 8 月至 9 月期间居住在沙特阿拉伯的成年人进行了一项横断面电子调查。参与者是通过社交媒体和电子通信渠道在线分发招募的。该调查问卷评估了有关 COVID-19 的社会人口特征、知识和看法,以及在反映疫苗成本以及科学安全性和有效性证据的可用性的五种假设情景下接受 COVID-19 疫苗接种的意愿。进行多变量逻辑回归分析以确定与疫苗接种意愿相关的因素。结果:共有 1293 名受访者完成了调查。当免费提供疫苗接种时,57.5% 的参与者表示他们可能会接种疫苗。随着假设疫苗价格的上涨,疫苗接种意愿下降,当成本超过 100 SAR 时,疫苗接种意愿下降至 38.7%。当在安全性和有效性证据尚未得到证实的情况下接种疫苗时,意愿最低。在多种情况下,年龄、性别、教育程度和之前接种季节性流感疫苗与 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿相关。结论:在沙特阿拉伯大流行的早期阶段,疫苗的可负担性以及对科学安全性和有效性证据的信心是与 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿相关的重要因素。在不向接受者产生直接费用的情况下提供疫苗接种,并透明地传达安全性和有效性证据,可能会在未来大规模免疫运动中支持公众信心和疫苗接受度。这些发现应被解释为大流行早期的基线,不应推断为当前推出后的态度。

papers.title: Pre-existing Immunity to H1N1 Influenza Virus Improves Antibody Response to Vaccination through Germinal Center Regulation
papers.abstract: Abstract Influenza viruses circulate annually in humans, accumulating mutations in the viral genome. In real world conditions, people develop an immune history from multiple influenza virus infections and vaccinations, yet most experimental studies utilize naïve hosts to investigate viral pathogenesis or vaccine efficacy; a scenario that does not reflect actual human exposure and immune responses. Here, we report that mice previously infected with the mouse-adapted H1N1 virus mounted an increased antibody response after vaccination with the split virion quadrivalent seasonal influenza vaccine. Antibodies targeting the H1 antigen component of the vaccine in H1N1 preimmune mice had titers peaking at 8 HAI units versus 2 HAI units in naïve-vaccinated mice at 14 days post-vaccination, whereas H3N2 pre-immune mice showed no improved vaccine responses. Increased IgG class-switched isotype antibodies in the H1N1 pre-immune-vaccinated mice correlated with protection from weight loss and mortality when these mice were challenged with an H1N1 pandemic 2009 strain. Temporal sampling and analysis of RNA from mediastinal lymph nodes from preimmune mice by RNA-seq at time points following vaccination revealed distinct regulation of lymphocyte and germinal center-specific genes, including BCL6, an essential gene for germinal-center-dependent B-cells. Taken together, we demonstrate that H1N1 A/FM/1/1947 pre-immunity led to a more efficient vaccine response, possibly regulated by germinal center mechanisms in the mediastinal lymph node; a finding with implications for future vaccine design.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 流感病毒每年在人类中传播,病毒基因组中不断积累突变。在现实世界中,人们会因多次流感病毒感染和疫苗接种而产生免疫史,但大多数实验研究利用幼稚宿主来研究病毒发病机制或疫苗功效;这种情况不能反映实际的人类暴露和免疫反应。在这里,我们报告说,先前感染过小鼠适应性 H1N1 病毒的小鼠在接种裂解病毒颗粒四价季节性流感疫苗后,抗体反应增强。疫苗接种后 14 天,H1N1 预免疫小鼠中针对疫苗 H1 抗原成分的抗体滴度峰值达到 8 HAI 单位,而未接种疫苗的小鼠则为 2 HAI 单位,而 H3N2 预免疫小鼠的疫苗反应没有改善。当 H1N1 预免疫接种小鼠受到 2009 年 H1N1 流感病毒株攻击时,IgG 类别转换同种型抗体的增加与防止体重减轻和死亡相关。在疫苗接种后的时间点,通过 RNA-seq 对免疫前小鼠纵隔淋巴结的 RNA 进行时间采样和分析,揭示了淋巴细胞和生发中心特异性基因的明显调节,包括 BCL6(生发中心依赖性 B 细胞的必需基因)。综上所述,我们证明 H1N1 A/FM/1/1947 免疫前导致了更有效的疫苗反应,可能受到纵隔淋巴结生发中心机制的调节;这一发现对未来的疫苗设计具有影响。

analysis_zh.main_results: 当 H1N1 预免疫接种小鼠受到 2009 年 H1N1 流感病毒株攻击时,IgG 类别转换同种型抗体的增加与防止体重减轻和死亡相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 疫苗接种后 14 天,H1N1 预免疫小鼠中针对疫苗 H1 抗原成分的抗体滴度峰值达到 8 HAI 单位,而未接种疫苗的小鼠则为 2 HAI 单位,而 H3N2 预免疫小鼠的疫苗反应没有改善。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 综上所述,我们证明 H1N1 A/FM/1/1947 免疫前导致了更有效的疫苗反应,可能受到纵隔淋巴结生发中心机制的调节;这一发现对未来的疫苗设计具有影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这种确定性提取仅基于抽象。该消息来源没有明确报告独立评估的足够局限性,因此可信度较低。

papers.title: Influenza Antibody Levels Associated with Laboratory-Confirmed Influenza in a Test-Negative Study Design, US Flu VE Network, November 2018-May 2019.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background We assessed associations between antibody concentrations within 7 days of symptom onset and testing positive for influenza virus infection among outpatients enrolled in a test-negative study. Methods From November 2018─May 2019, study sites in five states obtained serum and respiratory specimens from outpatients aged ≥18 years presenting with acute respiratory illness. Respiratory specimens were tested for influenza virus, and viral clades were identified by genomic sequencing. We measured influenza antibody titers against vaccine and circulating viruses by hemagglutination inhibition (HI), microneutralization (MN) and neuraminidase inhibition (NAI) assays. Reduction in odds of influenza-associated illness at increasing HI, MN and NAI antibody titers was estimated using logistic regression adjusting for influenza vaccination status and time since beginning of influenza season. Results Among 175 patients with confirmed influenza virus infection, including 112 with influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and 63 with A(H3N2) (44 clade 3C.3a), and 130 test-negative control patients, higher HI, MN and NAI antibody titers against circulating influenza viruses were associated with lower odds of confirmed influenza. Odds of A(H1N1)pdm09 infection were 44% and 54% lower for each two-fold increase in A(H1N1)pdm09 HI or NAI titer, respectively. Odds of A(H3N2) infection were 49% and 28% lower, respectively, for each two-fold increase in MN or NAI titer against circulating A(H3N2) virus clade. NAI titers were independently associated with lower odds of influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2) after controlling for HI titer. Conclusion Higher influenza antibody titers against circulating viruses were associated with lower likelihood of influenza virus infection among adult patients with acute respiratory illness.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 我们评估了参加一项测试阴性研究的门诊患者中症状出现 7 天内的抗体浓度与流感病毒感染测试呈阳性之间的关联。方法 2018年11月至2019年5月,五个州的研究中心采集了年龄≥18岁的急性呼吸道疾病门诊患者的血清和呼吸道标本。对呼吸道标本进行了流感病毒检测,并通过基因组测序鉴定了病毒进化枝。我们通过血凝抑制(HI)、微量中和(MN)和神经氨酸酶抑制(NAI)测定来测量针对疫苗和循环病毒的流感抗体滴度。使用逻辑回归调整流感疫苗接种状态和自流感季节开始以来的时间,估计随着 HI、MN 和 NAI 抗体滴度的增加,流感相关疾病的几率降低。结果 在 175 名确诊流感病毒感染患者(包括 112 名甲型(H1N1)pdm09 流感患者和 63 名甲型(H3N2)流感(44 分支 3C.3a))和 130 名测试阴性对照患者中,针对循环流感病毒的 HI、MN 和 NAI 抗体滴度较高与确诊流感的几率较低相关。A(H1N1)pdm09 HI 或 NAI 滴度每增加两倍,A(H1N1)pdm09 感染的几率分别降低 44% 和 54%。针对循环 A(H3N2) 病毒分支的 MN 或 NAI 滴度每增加两倍,A(H3N2) 感染的几率分别降低 49% 和 28%。控制 HI 滴度后,NAI 滴度与甲型 (H1N1)pdm09 和甲型 (H3N2) 流感的较低几率独立相关。结论 针对循环病毒的流感抗体滴度较高与急性呼吸道疾病成年患者感染流感病毒的可能性较低相关。

papers.title: Influenza vaccine awareness and uptake patterns among women of reproductive age in Pudong New Area: A community-based cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The World Health Organization prioritizes pregnant women for influenza vaccination; in China, flu vaccination during pregnancy has not been widely adopted. This gap is due to a lack of targeted policies and limited public health promotion. We aimed to describe knowledge and attitudes toward seasonal influenza vaccination among women of reproductive age (15–49 y old) (WRA), to inform evidence-based policy interventions. A cross-sectional survey assessed WRA’s influenza and vaccine awareness, vaccination route preference, and influencing factors, analyzed via chi-square tests and multivariate logistic regression. The knowledge score among WRA in Shanghai Pudong was 3.77 ± 1.23, and the influenza vaccine knowledge score was 3.55 ± 1.66; the pass rates were 60.61% and 56.46%, respectively. Healthcare workers had the highest cognitive levels. Multivariate analysis indicated that education level and being a healthcare professional were predictors of the influenza vaccine pass rate. In particular, the preference for injection decreased sharply from 41.25% among non-pregnant women to 13.31% in the hypothetical pregnancy scenario. In comparison, nasal spray preference rose from 10.60% to 23.17%, and unwillingness increased from 10.19% to 35.58% (P < .05). Pregnant women preferred the nasal spray at 41.67%, a rate significantly higher than that of non-pregnant women (10.60%, P < .05). When receiving influenza vaccine recommendations, 87.63% of participants were more inclined to follow the advice of obstetricians and gynecologists. While WRA in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, demonstrates a relatively high level of attention to influenza and influenza vaccines, key gaps still exist. Strengthening obstetricians’ guidance, promoting non-injectable influenza vaccines, and delivering targeted health education are important strategies to improve vaccination uptake in this population.

papers.title: Vaccination recommendations to others among physicians and the general public: effects of birth-year-based vaccination policy changes assessed by regression discontinuity analysis
papers.abstract: Introduction: Recommendations from physicians and peers play a crucial role in promoting vaccination. This study evaluated differences in recommendations to others regarding four vaccines with varying efficacy (seasonal influenza, measles, human papillomavirus [HPV], and coronavirus disease 2019 [COVID-19]) between physicians and the general public and examined the impact of birth-year-based vaccination policy changes on these recommendations. Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted in February 2026 among 492 physicians and 5,252 members of the general public in Japan. Consistency in recommendations across the four vaccines was assessed using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC[3,1]), and group differences were examined using a two-way mixed-design analysis of covariance. Multilevel regression discontinuity analyses were performed to evaluate the effects of birth-year-based vaccination policy. Results: Physicians showed significantly stronger recommendations to others than the general public, and their recommendation patterns generally reflected vaccine efficacy. However, physicians showed lower consistency across vaccine types than the general public (ICC[3,1]), driven primarily by heterogeneity in COVID-19 vaccine recommendations. Regression discontinuity analyses showed that birth-year-based vaccination policy, including routine vaccination opportunities, was significantly associated with recommendations to others for measles and HPV vaccines, independently of perceived benefits and risks. Conclusion: To improve vaccination coverage from a public health perspective, it is important for physicians to provide effective vaccination recommendations to the general public on a broader scale; however, it is also necessary to address the heterogeneity in vaccine-specific recommendation patterns among physicians, as observed for COVID-19. Routine vaccination opportunities may increase vaccination coverage not only through the routine vaccination program itself but also through peer effects among the general public. Vaccination policy may therefore influence vaccination coverage not only in the current generation but also in future generations. Designing vaccination policy should consider its long-term impact on future vaccination coverage as well as herd immunity.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:医生和同行的建议在促进疫苗接种方面发挥着至关重要的作用。本研究评估了医生和公众对四种功效不同的疫苗(季节性流感、麻疹、人乳头瘤病毒 [HPV] 和 2019 年冠状病毒病 [COVID-19])向其他人的建议的差异,并研究了基于出生年份的疫苗接种政策变化对这些建议的影响。方法:这项横断面研究于 2026 年 2 月在日本对 492 名医生和 5,252 名公众进行了研究。使用组内相关系数 (ICC[3,1]) 评估四种疫苗建议的一致性,并使用协方差的双向混合设计分析检查组间差异。进行多水平回归断点分析来评估基于出生年份的疫苗接种政策的效果。结果:医生向他人提出的建议明显强于公众,他们的推荐模式通常反映了疫苗的功效。然而,医生对疫苗类型的一致性低于公众 (ICC[3,1]),这主要是由于 COVID-19 疫苗建议的异质性所致。回归断点分析表明,基于出生年份的疫苗接种政策(包括常规疫苗接种机会)与向其他人推荐麻疹和 HPV 疫苗显着相关,与感知的益处和风险无关。结论:为了从公共卫生角度提高疫苗接种覆盖率,医生必须在更广泛的范围内向公众提供有效的疫苗接种建议;然而,正如针对 COVID-19 所观察到的那样,还需要解决医生之间疫苗特定推荐模式的异质性问题。常规疫苗接种机会不仅可以通过常规疫苗接种计划本身,还可以通过公众中的同伴效应来提高疫苗接种覆盖率。因此,疫苗接种政策可能不仅影响当代人,而且影响子孙后代的疫苗接种覆盖率。设计疫苗接种政策应考虑其对未来疫苗接种覆盖率以及群体免疫的长期影响。

papers.title: Small Genome vs. Complex Retrovirus: Theoretical Considerations of Influenza A and HIV-1 Replication and Therapeutic Exploitation
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) remains a significant global health threat due to its rapid mutation rate, seasonal epidemics, and pandemic potential. Continuous viral evolution and emerging resistance to existing antivirals necessitate the evaluation of alternative or repurposed antiviral strategies. Tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), a phosphonamidite prodrug of tenofovir primarily used in antiretroviral therapy, has demonstrated intracellular stability and a favorable safety profile. In this study, we investigated the time- and concentration-dependent antiviral activity and cytotoxicity of TAF in Influenza A–infected cell culture over a 120-h period. Antiviral efficacy was quantified as percentage inhibition of viral replication, while cytotoxicity was assessed using the MTT assay to determine cell viability. TAF exhibited progressive, exposure-dependent suppression of Influenza A replication, with inhibition exceeding 80% at higher concentrations after prolonged incubation. Importantly, host cell viability remained ≥70% under corresponding conditions, and the CC50 was not reached within the tested concentration range. The estimated EC50 values indicated significant antiviral activity with a favourable selectivity window. These findings suggest that TAF exerts time-dependent inhibitory effects on Influenza A virus while preserving cellular viability, supporting further investigation of nucleotide-analogue–based strategies for RNA virus replication control.
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology

papers.title_zh: 小基因组与复杂逆转录病毒:甲型流感和 HIV-1 复制和治疗利用的理论考虑
papers.source_body_en: Influenza A virus (IAV) remains a significant global health threat due to its rapid mutation rate, seasonal epidemics, and pandemic potential. Continuous viral evolution and emerging resistance to existing antivirals necessitate the evaluation of alternative or repurposed antiviral strategies. Tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), a phosphonamidite prodrug of tenofovir primarily used in antiretroviral therapy, has demonstrated intracellular stability and a favorable safety profile. In this study, we investigated the time- and concentration-dependent antiviral activity and cytotoxicity of TAF in Influenza A–infected cell culture over a 120-h period. Antiviral efficacy was quantified as percentage inhibition of viral replication, while cytotoxicity was assessed using the MTT assay to determine cell viability. TAF exhibited progressive, exposure-dependent suppression of Influenza A replication, with inhibition exceeding 80% at higher concentrations after prolonged incubation. Importantly, host cell viability remained ≥70% under corresponding conditions, and the CC50 was not reached within the tested concentration range. The estimated EC50 values indicated significant antiviral activity with a favourable selectivity window. These findings suggest that TAF exerts time-dependent inhibitory effects on Influenza A virus while preserving cellular viability, supporting further investigation of nucleotide-analogue–based strategies for RNA virus replication control.

papers.title: The Resurgence of Respiratory Viruses After COVID-19: Molecular Insights from Pediatric SARI in Kashmir.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory viruses are major contributors to severe acute respiratory infections (SARI) in children. Data on their molecular epidemiology in northern India remains limited, particularly in the post-COVID-19 period. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and distribution of respiratory viral pathogens among hospitalized pediatric SARI patients in Kashmir. METHODS: A prospective study was conducted from October 2023 to April 2025 at Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar. Children aged ≤15 years meeting the World Health Organization SARI case definition were enrolled. Nasopharyngeal and/or oropharyngeal samples were collected and tested using real-time polymerase chain reaction assays for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and B, Respiratory Syncytial virus (RSV) A and B, Adenovirus, Human metapneumovirus, Rhinovirus, and Para-influenza viruses. RESULTS: A total of 326 pediatric SARI cases were included. At least one respiratory virus was detected in 200 patients (61.3%). RSV was the most frequently detected virus, with RSV-B identified in 111 cases (34.0%) and RSV-A in 26 cases (7.9%). Influenza viruses accounted for a smaller proportion, including influenza A(H1N1) in 12 cases (3.6%), influenza A(H3N2) in 6 cases (1.8%), and influenza B (Victoria lineage) in 21 cases (6.4%). Other viruses detected included Adenovirus, Para-influenza virus, Rhinovirus, and Human metapneumovirus. Most infections occurred during winter months and predominantly affected infants. CONCLUSION: Respiratory viruses account for a substantial proportion of pediatric SARI cases in Kashmir, with RSV emerging as the predominant pathogen in the post-pandemic period. Strengthening molecular surveillance may improve diagnostic stewardship and guide targeted prevention strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Respiratory viruses are major causes of severe acute respiratory infections (SARI) in children, yet molecular epidemiology data from northern India, particularly after the COVID-19 pandemic, remains sparse. This study addressed the knowledge gap by determining the prevalence and distribution of respiratory viral pathogens among hospitalized pediatric SARI patients in Kashmir.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A prospective study was conducted from October 2023 to April 2025 at Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar. Children aged ≤15 years meeting the WHO SARI case definition were enrolled, and nasopharyngeal and/or oropharyngeal samples were collected.
analysis.methods: Samples were tested using real-time polymerase chain reaction assays for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and B, Respiratory Syncytial virus (RSV) A and B, Adenovirus, Human metapneumovirus, Rhinovirus, and Para-influenza viruses.
analysis.main_results: A total of 326 pediatric SARI cases were included, with at least one respiratory virus detected in 200 patients (61.3%). RSV was the most frequently detected virus, with RSV-B identified in 111 cases (34.0%) and RSV-A in 26 cases (7.9%). Influenza viruses accounted for 39 cases (12.0%), including influenza A(H1N1) in 12 cases (3.6%), influenza A(H3N2) in 6 cases (1.8%), and influenza B (Victoria lineage) in 21 cases (6.4%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights RSV as the predominant pathogen in pediatric SARI cases in Kashmir during the post-pandemic period, contrasting with the pre-pandemic predominance of other respiratory viruses. This shift underscores the need for updated molecular surveillance and targeted prevention strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the importance of strengthening molecular surveillance to improve diagnostic accuracy and guide targeted prevention strategies, particularly for RSV, in pediatric populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-centre design and lack of longitudinal follow-up, which may affect generalisability and temporal trends. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of a control group and potential selection bias in a hospital-based cohort.

Influenza viruses accounted for 12.0% of cases, including A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B (Victoria lineage). Most infections occurred in winter and predominantly affected infants. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道病毒是儿童严重急性呼吸道感染 (SARI) 的主要原因,但印度北部的分子流行病学数据,特别是在 COVID-19 大流行之后,仍然很少。本研究通过确定克什米尔住院儿科 SARI 患者中呼吸道病毒病原体的流行率和分布来解决知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023 年 10 月至 2025 年 4 月在斯利那加谢尔克什米尔医学科学研究所进行了一项前瞻性研究。纳入符合WHO SARI病例定义的年龄≤15岁的儿童,并采集鼻咽和/或口咽样本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用实时聚合酶链反应检测对 SARS-CoV-2、甲型和乙型流感、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) A 和 B、腺病毒、人类偏肺病毒、鼻病毒和副流感病毒进行检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共纳入了 326 例儿童 SARI 病例,其中 200 例患者(61.3%)中至少检测到一种呼吸道病毒。RSV 是最常检测到的病毒,其中 RSV-B 在 111 例(34.0%)中检出,RSV-A 在 26 例(7.9%)中检出。流感病毒占39例(12.0%),其中甲型H1N1流感12例(3.6%),甲型H3N2流感6例(1.8%),乙型流感(维多利亚系)21例(6.4%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调RSV是大流行后时期克什米尔儿童SARS病例的主要病原体,与大流行前其他呼吸道病毒占主导地位形成鲜明对比。这一转变强调了更新分子监测和有针对性的预防策略的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了加强分子监测以提高诊断准确性和指导有针对性的预防策略的重要性,特别是针对儿童群体中的 RSV。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其单中心设计和缺乏纵向随访而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性和时间趋势。由于缺乏对照组以及医院队列中潜在的选择偏差,证据强度中等。

METHODS: A prospective study was conducted from October 2023 to April 2025 at Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar. Children aged ≤15 years meeting the World Health Organization SARI case definition were enrolled. Nasopharyngeal and/or oropharyngeal samples were collected and tested using real-time polymerase chain reaction assays for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and B, Respiratory Syncytial virus (RSV) A and B, Adenovirus, Human metapneumovirus, Rhinovirus, and Para-influenza viruses. RESULTS: A total of 326 pediatric SARI cases were included. At least one respiratory virus was detected in 200 patients (61.3%). RSV was the most frequently detected virus, with RSV-B identified in 111 cases (34.0%) and RSV-A in 26 cases (7.9%). Influenza viruses accounted for a smaller proportion, including influenza A(H1N1) in 12 cases (3.6%), influenza A(H3N2) in 6 cases (1.8%), and influenza B (Victoria lineage) in 21 cases (6.4%). Other viruses detected included Adenovirus, Para-influenza virus, Rhinovirus, and Human metapneumovirus. Most infections occurred during winter months and predominantly affected infants. CONCLUSION: Respiratory viruses account for a substantial proportion of pediatric SARI cases in Kashmir, with RSV emerging as the predominant pathogen in the post-pandemic period. Strengthening molecular surveillance may improve diagnostic stewardship and guide targeted prevention strategies.

papers.title: Synthesis of Glycooligomers with Defined Sialyllactose Valency and Spacing for Multivalent Binding to Influenza Hemagglutinin
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus is a medically important target. Hemagglutinin (HA), a trimeric glycoprotein on the viral surface, recognizes sialylated glycans through three receptor-binding sites. Glycoligands that interact with HA through multivalent binding can serve as viral inhibitors. To achieve efficient multivalent binding, precise control over glycoligand structures is essential. Here, we synthesized glycooligomers displaying sialyllactose units at defined intramolecular spacings and investigated how ligand structure affects binding to HA. Glycooligomers displaying one, two, or three sialyllactose units at regular intervals exhibited enhanced binding as carbohydrate valency increased. When the spacing between two sialyllactose units was varied, shorter spacing enhanced binding, likely because of a statistical rebinding effect. Interestingly, the presentation of an excessive number of sialyllactose units weakened the interaction with HA, presumably because of steric hindrance. These findings highlight the importance of precise carbohydrate arrangement in the design of effective multivalent ligands.

papers.title: The signaling adaptor insulin receptor substrate 2 (IRS2) limits lethal host responses induced by influenza infection.
papers.abstract: Influenza is a highly contagious virus with most individuals showing recovery within a week after symptom onset. However, children, the elderly, and those with chronic health conditions are at high risk of developing serious complications. Extensive immune cell infiltration of the lung and massive production of pro-inflammatory cytokines can result in lung tissue damage and disruption, resulting in hypoxia and death. During the 2024-2025 influenza season in the USA, influenza caused an estimated 27,000-130,000 deaths. Our previous studies have shown that agents known to drive polarization of macrophages into the M2a phenotype mitigated inflammatory responses to influenza H1N1 A/PR/8/34 (PR8). Since IRS2 dampens the IL-4-induced differentiation to the M2a subtype, we sought to determine the impact of IRS2 on PR8 infection. Contrary to expectations, IRS2-/- mice exhibited enhanced susceptibility to PR8 when compared to IRS2+/+ mice, which was associated with a significant drop in blood oxygen saturation. Additionally, PR8 infection induced significantly greater inflammation in the lungs of IRS2-/- mice than IRS2+/+ mice. Conversely, viral replication was not significantly different. Significantly increased levels of the inflammatory mediator HMGB1 and airway epithelial cell denuding were observed in the lungs of IRS2-/- mice, with a concomitant decrease in M2a gene expression. Mice with myeloid-specific knockout of IRS2 showed no enhanced sensitivity to PR8, supporting the hypothesis that the major impact of IRS2-deficiency on host response to PR8 infection is not myeloid cell-intrinsic. Overall, these results suggest that in the absence of IRS2, airway epithelial cells are especially sensitive to influenza-induced damage through dysregulated inflammation, resulting in increased susceptibility during infection.

papers.title_zh: 信号适配器胰岛素受体底物 2 (IRS2) 限制流感感染引起的致命宿主反应。
papers.source_body_en: Influenza is a highly contagious virus with most individuals showing recovery within a week after symptom onset. However, children, the elderly, and those with chronic health conditions are at high risk of developing serious complications. Extensive immune cell infiltration of the lung and massive production of pro-inflammatory cytokines can result in lung tissue damage and disruption, resulting in hypoxia and death. During the 2024-2025 influenza season in the USA, influenza caused an estimated 27,000-130,000 deaths. Our previous studies have shown that agents known to drive polarization of macrophages into the M2a phenotype mitigated inflammatory responses to influenza H1N1 A/PR/8/34 (PR8). Since IRS2 dampens the IL-4-induced differentiation to the M2a subtype, we sought to determine the impact of IRS2 on PR8 infection. Contrary to expectations, IRS2-/- mice exhibited enhanced susceptibility to PR8 when compared to IRS2+/+ mice, which was associated with a significant drop in blood oxygen saturation. Additionally, PR8 infection induced significantly greater inflammation in the lungs of IRS2-/- mice than IRS2+/+ mice. Conversely, viral replication was not significantly different. Significantly increased levels of the inflammatory mediator HMGB1 and airway epithelial cell denuding were observed in the lungs of IRS2-/- mice, with a concomitant decrease in M2a gene expression. Mice with myeloid-specific knockout of IRS2 showed no enhanced sensitivity to PR8, supporting the hypothesis that the major impact of IRS2-deficiency on host response to PR8 infection is not myeloid cell-intrinsic. Overall, these results suggest that in the absence of IRS2, airway epithelial cells are especially sensitive to influenza-induced damage through dysregulated inflammation, resulting in increased susceptibility during infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 流感是一种高度传染性的病毒,大多数人在症状出现后一周内就会康复。然而,儿童、老年人和患有慢性疾病的人出现严重并发症的风险很高。肺部广泛的免疫细胞浸润和促炎细胞因子的大量产生可导致肺组织损伤和破坏,导致缺氧和死亡。在美国 2024-2025 年流感季节,流感估计导致 27,000-130,000 人死亡。我们之前的研究表明,已知可驱动巨噬细胞极化为 M2a 表型的药物可减轻对流感 H1N1 A/PR/8/34 (PR8) 的炎症反应。由于 IRS2 抑制 IL-4 诱导的向 M2a 亚型的分化,我们试图确定 IRS2 对 PR8 感染的影响。与预期相反,与 IRS2+/+ 小鼠相比,IRS2-/- 小鼠表现出对 PR8 的敏感性增强,这与血氧饱和度显着下降有关。此外,与IRS2+/+小鼠相比,PR8感染在IRS2-/-小鼠的肺部引起明显更严重的炎症。相反,病毒复制没有显着差异。在 IRS2-/- 小鼠的肺部观察到炎症介质 HMGB1 水平显着增加和气道上皮细胞剥脱,同时 M2a 基因表达减少。骨髓特异性敲除 IRS2 的小鼠对 PR8 的敏感性并未增强,这支持了以下假设:IRS2 缺陷对宿主对 PR8 感染反应的主要影响不是骨髓细胞固有的。总体而言,这些结果表明,在缺乏 IRS2 的情况下,气道上皮细胞对流感通过炎症失调引起的损伤特别敏感,导致感染期间的易感性增加。

papers.title: Rapid clinical validation of an RNA/DNA hybrid tagmentation-based metagenomic workflow for respiratory RNA virus detection
papers.abstract: Background In the post-pandemic era, co-circulation of multiple respiratory RNA viruses has increased the need for timely diagnosis and reliable recognition of mixed infections. Although reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) remains the clinical standard for respiratory virus detection, its target-restricted design limits the detection of unexpected or coinfecting pathogens. Conventional metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) provides hypothesis-free pathogen detection, but routine clinical use is still limited by long turnaround times and complex library preparation. Therefore, a sequencing-based strategy that preserves broad, unbiased detection while offering a simplified workflow and clinically acceptable turnaround time is needed. Methods We optimized and clinically validated CATCH, a rapid RNA/DNA hybrid tagmentation-based mNGS workflow, for respiratory RNA virus detection. Analytical performance was assessed using standardized reference materials, including SARS-CoV-2 and influenza A virus, with evaluations of sensitivity, reproducibility, short-term stability, and host-background interference. Clinical validation was performed in retrospective and prospective respiratory infection cohorts, and assay performance was benchmarked against RT-qPCR and multiplex PCR. The same sequencing data were further examined for semiquantitative viral assessment, coinfection detection, and exploratory respiratory microbial profiling. Results The optimized CATCH workflow shortened library preparation to approximately 3 h, with about 35 min of hands-on time, enabling same-day sequencing-based diagnostics. Broad detection was achieved across seven clinically relevant respiratory RNA viruses. Sequencing-derived viral abundance showed a significant overall correlation with viral input concentration, supporting semiquantitative interpretation, although virus- and subtype-specific variability highlighted biological constraints on absolute quantification. Using SARS-CoV-2 and influenza A virus as representative targets, CATCH achieved clinically actionable limits of detection with high reproducibility and stability. In clinical cohorts, CATCH showed high concordance with routine molecular assays and identified mixed respiratory infections missed by targeted testing. Exploratory analyses also demonstrated the feasibility of respiratory microbial community profiling from the same sequencing dataset. Conclusion CATCH is a rapid and clinically deployable RNA virus mNGS workflow that helps bridge targeted molecular diagnostics and conventional metagenomic sequencing. By combining broad pathogen detection, coinfection identification, and semiquantitative assessment within a streamlined workflow, CATCH provides a practical framework for comprehensive respiratory RNA virus diagnosis and syndromic surveillance.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景在后大流行时代,多种呼吸道RNA病毒的共同循环增加了对混合感染的及时诊断和可靠识别的需求。尽管逆转录定量聚合酶链反应 (RT-qPCR) 仍然是呼吸道病毒检测的临床标准,但其目标限制设计限制了意外或共感染病原体的检测。传统的宏基因组下一代测序(mNGS)提供无假设的病原体检测,但常规临床使用仍然受到周转时间长和文库制备复杂的限制。因此,需要一种基于测序的策略,既保留广泛、公正的检测,同时提供简化的工作流程和临床可接受的周转时间。方法 我们优化并进行了临床验证 CATCH,这是一种基于快速 RNA/DNA 混合标签的 mNGS 工作流程,用于呼吸道 RNA 病毒检测。使用标准化参考材料(包括 SARS-CoV-2 和甲型流感病毒)评估分析性能,并评估灵敏度、重现性、短期稳定性和宿主背景干扰。在回顾性和前瞻性呼吸道感染队列中进行了临床验证,并以 RT-qPCR 和多重 PCR 为基准对检测性能进行了基准测试。进一步检查相同的测序数据以进行半定量病毒评估、合并感染检测和探索性呼吸道微生物分析。结果 优化的 CATCH 工作流程将文库准备时间缩短至约 3 小时,实际操作时间约为 35 分钟,从而实现当天基于测序的诊断。对七种临床相关呼吸道 RNA 病毒进行了广泛检测。测序得出的病毒丰度显示出与病毒输入浓度显着的总体相关性,支持半定量解释,尽管病毒和亚型特异性的变异性突出了绝对定量的生物学限制。CATCH 使用 SARS-CoV-2 和甲型流感病毒作为代表性靶标,实现了临床可行的检测限,并具有高重现性和稳定性。在临床队列中,CATCH 显示出与常规分子检测的高度一致性,并发现了目标检测漏掉的混合呼吸道感染。探索性分析还证明了从同一测序数据集进行呼吸道微生物群落分析的可行性。结论 CATCH 是一种快速且可临床部署的 RNA 病毒 mNGS 工作流程,有助于连接靶向分子诊断和传统宏基因组测序。通过将广泛的病原体检测、共感染识别和半定量评估结合在简化的工作流程中,CATCH 为全面的呼吸道 RNA 病毒诊断和症状监测提供了实用的框架。

Monthly counts: 242 (April), 383 (May), 414 (June), and 324 by mid-July. Officials note a sharper monsoon-associated rise compared to 2025 (April: 234, May: 95, June: 125, July total: 383). Two seasonal influenza peaks expected annually; the monsoon peak (July–September) is often larger.
analysis_en.response_status_and_uncertainty: Health department directed districts to strengthen influenza surveillance, ensure adequate sample collection and laboratory consumables, and maintain stocks of Oseltamivir, PPE, and N95 masks. Hospitals instructed to prepare ventilators for severe cases and intensify public awareness on hygiene and early care. Officials state cases may rise further over the next two months but preparedness has been ramped up. No information on hospitalization or mortality rates provided.

news.title_zh: 季风燃料在流感病例中增加;卡纳塔克邦卫生部门加强监测 - 印度时报
news.source_body_en: Karnataka is experiencing a sharp rise in seasonal influenza cases during the 2026 monsoon, with 2,056 laboratory-confirmed infections reported from January through mid-July. The surge has accelerated in recent months, reaching 414 cases in June and 324 by the second week of July—outpacing the same period in 2025 and reflecting a monsoon-associated pattern. Health authorities convened an emergency review and directed districts to bolster surveillance, ensure adequate testing supplies, and stockpile antivirals and protective equipment. Hospitals have been asked to ready ventilators for severe cases and launch public campaigns on hygiene and early care. While officials anticipate further increases over the next two months, they emphasize that preparedness measures have been strengthened.
